text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking with Mejiro<n>Dober in the
shopping district...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clang-clang! Clang-clang!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with<n>our New Year's
raffle! This year's<n>grand prize is a hot spring
vacation<n>for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot<n>hamburger
steak! Second-prize<n>winners get a bushel of
carrots! And<n>third-prize winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you<n>by! Get a ticket
now and spin for your<n>chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh, they're holding a raffle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Why don't we give it a try, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Someone's eager.
Someone's eager.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So what if I am? I didn't draw a<n>fortune on New
Year's, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I am. I didn't draw a<n>fortune on New
Year's, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I thought this would be a good chance<n>to test our
luck. So? What do you<n>think?
choice_data_list: All right, let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I thought this would be a good chance<n>to test our
luck. So? What do you<n>think?
choice_data_list: All right, let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Let's get a ticket, then. Let's<n>see... Looks
like we'll have to make a<n>purchase in order to get a
raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober and I go off to buy<n>some things in
order to get a ticket.<n>Once we do, we return to the
location<n>of the raffle, and...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober and I give the raffle<n>machine a
powerful spin together!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the<n>tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves<n>a grand-prize
winner! Come and get<n>the coupon for your hot
spring<n>vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-we got the grand prize?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Incredible... I can't believe our luckturned out this good!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Why, that's the same as drawing asuper-duper great fortune at thetemple!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right! This is so much<n>better than a
regular great fort—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait, Fukukitaru?!
choice_data_list: Oh, aren't you one of Dober's friends?
Oh, aren't you one of Dober's friends?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! The name's<n>Matikanefukukitaru! Happy
New<n>Year!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I was just in that nearby bookstore<n>when I heard
mention of the word<n>"luck" and realized I was being
summoned by the universe!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But to think you won the grand prize!<n>What
super-duper great luck indeed!<n>This is an indication
that your future<n>together will be a very bright one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Um... Thank you? I think?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
While we're at it, would you like me<n>to read your
fortune, Dober? I can<n>determine when you should
go to the<n>hot spring—and with whom!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: Why not? Sounds like a good opportunity to me.
Why not? Sounds like a good opportunity to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? W-wait!
I've got it!
Already?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You must go when both of your<n>affairs have calmed
down. And the<n>ideal person to go with is someone
who is always by your side!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I shall take my leave! I<n>bid you both
adieu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hmph...
choice_data_list: You seem mad.
That's how fortunes are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What an extremely vague fortune...
choice_data_list: You seem mad.
That's how fortunes are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You didn't let me answer for myself<n>and just let
her do whatever she<n>wanted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Anyway, if either of us<n>wants to go
with someone else, we<n>can just give them this
voucher.

Anyway, I'll hold on to the voucher<n>until things calm
down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But if we end up deciding to go<n>together, well... We
can cross that<n>bridge when we get to it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, Mejiro Dober takes the<n>voucher for
safekeeping.

With that, Mejiro Dober takes the<n>voucher for
safekeeping.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize<n>winner!
Congratulations! You get one<n>deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: We won the first prize? No way...
choice_data_list:
Wow, that's like drawing a great fortune on New
Year's!

Wow, that's like drawing a great fortune on New
Year's!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what are you so excited<n>about? I mean, I
know I was the one<n>who mentioned it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're right. Maybe this is a<n>sign of good
things to come!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You two sure are close. Here,<n>have a bonus
gift as a treat!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You two sure are close. Here,<n>have a bonus
gift as a treat!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wha?! W-we're not close at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? A bonus gift? We couldn't<n>possibly accept...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here you go—two pieces of candy.<n>That's all
you're getting, since I<n>can't be handing out extra
steaks<n>willy-nilly. Be good and share those,<n>now!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here you go—two pieces of candy.<n>That's all
you're getting, since I<n>can't be handing out extra
steaks<n>willy-nilly. Be good and share those,<n>now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: O-oh! Uh, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Um, anyway... about the prize we just<n>won—
choice_data_list: Which flavor do you want?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, you mean the candy? If it's<n>between
orange and strawberry, I<n>guess I prefer the
strawberry.
choice_data_list:
Okay. I'll make sure to give it to you along with this
hamburger steak when we part ways.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay. Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Right, yeah... Trainer wouldn't ask<n>me to eat it
together. What was I<n>thinking?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Am I out of my mind? This isn't<n>some cheesy
manga—it's real life!)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why, but Mejiro Dober<n>starts
smacking her head as if<n>reprimanding herself as
we leave the<n>shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's<n>your lucky day!
You're going home<n>with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Hehe. I guess this would<n>equate to drawing a
good fortune,<n>huh?
choice_data_list: Not bad!
Not bad!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah... It's not bad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I hope this is a sign of even<n>better things to
come.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm glad we did this together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm glad we did this together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Especially since we'll be walking the<n>same path
together for so much long—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait. Forget you heard anything. I feel<n>like I just
said something really<n>embarrassing...
choice_data_list: I didn't think it was?
I didn't think it was?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, it was, so forget it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I guess it's fine if it doesn't bother<n>you...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As we walk home in the light of the<n>setting sun,
Mejiro Dober's cheeks<n>seem just a bit redder
than normal.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As we walk home in the light of the<n>setting sun,
Mejiro Dober's cheeks<n>seem just a bit redder
than normal.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won<n>the third prize!
Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I suppose this is the same as a<n>modest fortune.
Hehe.
choice_data_list: You look pretty pleased about it.
You look pretty pleased about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And what's wrong with that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I just feel like it's a fitting prize for<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Winning this means there are still<n>greater and
higher heights I can aim<n>for.
choice_data_list: That's a good point.
That's a good point.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Winning this means there are still<n>greater and
higher heights I can aim<n>for.
choice_data_list: That's a good point.
That's a good point.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right. That's why I have to keep up<n>this
momentum.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right. That's why I have to keep up<n>this
momentum.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: After all, this is just the start...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober smiles as she looks at<n>the lone
carrot she won.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you<n>pulled a blank one!
Take this pack of<n>tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh... We didn't win anything...
choice_data_list: Do you want to try again?
It's okay! How about we try again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...
choice_data_list: Do you want to try again?
It's okay! How about we try again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, forget it. You're only supposed to<n>draw your
fortune once, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, forget it. You're only supposed to<n>draw your
fortune once, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'd already decided to work hard no<n>matter what
the results were, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I shouldn't have even<n>suggested doing this
raffle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh. Sorry for making things weirdand forcing you to walk oneggshells...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As we head home, I try reassuring<n>Mejiro Dober
that she has nothing to<n>feel bad about, but she
remains<n>despondent.
